title: Michael Jackson Movie Is Still in Theaters, But You Can Preorder the 4K Ultra HD Blu-ray Online Now
summary: With prices starting at $29.96, here's where you can preorder Michael (2026) on DVD, Blu-ray and 4K Steelbook.
contentText:

With the box-office success of Michael (taking in nearly $219 million worldwide so far), fans are itching to watch the Michael Jackson biopic again and again in the best picture and audio quality at home. Although it’s still in theaters, you can preorder the movie right now.

With prices starting at $29.96, Michael (2026) is available for preorder on Amazon, and the listing is the No. 1 best-seller from the retail giant.

As of this writing, Lionsgate hasn’t announced a release date, but it’s likely that Michael would drop on physical media sometime in late July or early August. Meanwhile, the biopic comes on DVD, Blu-ray and 4K Ultra HD Blu-ray Steelbook.

And since the home video release is from Amazon, you can get Michael shipped to you for free if you’re a Prime member. However, if you’re not a Prime member, your online shopping basket has to be over $35 for free shipping.

Directed by Antoine Fuqua, Michael follows the early life of Michael Jackson (Jaafar Jackson) from stardom with The Jackson 5 to going solo and becoming the biggest and most popular entertainer in the world as the “King of Pop.”

The movie also stars Nia Long, Juliano Valdi, KeiLyn Durrel Jones, Laura Harrier, Jessica Sula, Mike Myers, Miles Teller, Colman Domingo and others.

Michael is available for preorder on Amazon. Prices start at $29.96 for the biopic on DVD. Once the release is ready to ship, Amazon would send you an email notification letting you know when you’d the movie delivered to your home.
